text:
devops-dan: FYI rolled a small IAM role-boundary + tighter egress CIDR change to eu-west this morning to lock down nodes. seeing some GPU pools fail to decrypt keystore tokens. opening thread so we can triage quickly.

deploy-bot: config-change: iam/role-boundary tightened in account:rdw-eu-prod by devops-dan at 2673456700 :truck:

sre-liz: I see repeated errors in kubelet logs from warm pool nodes: 
```
2026-04-12T08:12:03Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd
```
Queue length for pending GPU allocs spiked from 20 -> 320 in 6m.

anya-engineer: a few embed ingestion jobs failed with `keystore decrypt` errors, autoscaler can't attach. rolling errors in staging too? staging looks fine. prod-only so far.

matt-platform: Sounds like the role boundary change removed principal that the node-assume-role used to assume the keystore role. Did we include the node pool role in the new boundary allowed list?

devops-dan: Confirmed: boundary policy replaced `iam:PassRole` condition to a stricter AWS account CIDR and removed cross-account-principal exception. Intent was to prevent leaked roles from other accounts. I forgot to include the `node-keystore-assume` principal for legacy warm pool.

security-ana: We tightened because of an audit flag — cross-account role usage wasn't scoped. But we can make a specific exception for the node pool principal with an allowlist. Need to preserve audit trail. Suggest add explicit `iam:PassRole` exception + keep cloudtrail log retention.

sre-liz: Mitigations we can do now: (1) re-add the principal to role boundary (fast), (2) temporarily widen egress CIDR so nodes can hit privatelink keystore endpoint (if it's a networking block), (3) fallback to cross-region keystore fallback which will increase egress cost but unblocks. Which is least-impact?

devops-dan: quick test: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456:role/node-keystore-assume` from a control plane instance fails with AccessDenied. So it's definitely role boundary. Not a privatelink/CIDR issue.

matt-platform: Okay we can patch role-boundary to allow `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/node-keystore-assume` via terraform. Proposed command: `terraform apply -target=module.iam_role_boundary.aws_iam_policy.role_boundary -var 'allow_node_pool_principal=true'` — I'll stand by to apply if SRE wants.

anya-engineer: note: if we patch boundary, some nodes will still have queued requests and autoscaler backlog; we should restart node agents after change to flush cache.

security-ana: Before we allow, please add a one-line justification to the role-boundary change request and set a 90d expiry tag. We need auditability.

sre-liz: Agreed. Also watch KMS usage: if we switch to cross-region fallback we will pay more for decrypts and data transfer. Current decrypt volume estimate ~ 12k/day for warm pool churn. Cross-region would add ~€0.02/decrypt + egress; could be ~€240/day if we go that route — not great.

devops-dan: I'm going to roll a conservative patch to role boundary with the explicit principal and an annotated change request, then re-run node agent rolling. Will coordinate with security for the expiry tag.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-0457 (severity: medium) — linked to this thread.

deploy-bot: planned apply: `terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.iam_role_boundary` by matt-platform at 2673459000 — will run in 5m.

matt-platform: apply done. confirm?

sre-liz: After apply, doing a rolling daemonset restart on one warm pool AZ to validate: `kubectl rollout restart ds/node-agent -n infra --selector=pool=warm-eu1`

anya-engineer: I see decrypts succeeding for the restarted AZ, queue dropping. autoscaler attaching now. :thumbsup:

security-ana: Thanks — please push the change request with the justification and set `expiry=2026-07-01` tag on the role. Also we'll keep KMS CloudTrail at high fidelity for next 7 days.

devops-dan: Logged change request CR-2026-378, added expiry tag, set revert window 72h.

sre-liz: Monitoring: GPU allocation backlog down to 7, node churn stable. Will watch for any replayed failures.

matt-platform: follow-up action: run an inventory of all role boundaries to find other missing principals. I'll open a ticket.

security-ana: Also let's document the approved exception in infra runbook so on-call knows to add tagged exception instead of widening egress.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0457 status -> mitigated, monitoring.

devops-dan: thanks all. Lesson learned — we'll add a preflight check to IaC PRs for role-boundary impacts on service principals.

sre-liz: closing thread, will keep watch and update if anything regresses.
